headline: Gold Fields Discloses $3.3 Billion in Cumulative Payments to Ghana Government
summary: Gold Fields Ghana reported paying $3.3 billion to Ghana's government in royalties, taxes, and dividends from its Tarkwa mine. Capital investments in the operation exceeded $5 billion.
why: Gold Fields is a major international precious metals mining producer listed in South Africa.

impacts.name: Gold Fields
impacts.why: Fiscal disclosure details reflect Gold Fields' operating exposure and host country tax arrangements.
